evals.name: interactive-work-brainstorm
evals.prompt: /mytodo tomorrow I need to follow up with Sarah about the contract, also I should book the flight for the Austin trip and remember to submit my expense report from last week
evals.expected_output: Claude parses into ~3 atomic to-dos with short imperative titles, presents as a numbered markdown list, asks whether anything needs editing, then asks for a project/area, then asks for a schedule, then calls scripts/things_add.py --stdin with the finalized JSON.

evals.name: quick-mode-inbox-dump
evals.prompt: /mytodo --quick pick up dry cleaning, call mom, order new running shoes, check warranty on dishwasher
evals.expected_output: Four to-dos added straight to Inbox with no follow-up questions. Single-line confirmation. Each item has only a title — no when/list fields.

evals.name: interactive-single-item-with-notes
evals.prompt: /mytodo I need to prepare a 10-minute presentation for the all-hands next Thursday covering the key metrics from last quarter and any notable customer wins
evals.expected_output: One to-do with a short title like 'Prepare all-hands presentation' and notes carrying the duration, date, and topic list. Schedule proposed around next Thursday. Asks for project/area before submitting.
